prompt:
Asset sheet of the whole 'Bairro de Fátima' neighbourhood of Huambo, Angola. Every public building carries a clearly readable Portuguese sign that includes the neighbourhood name. Draw ALL of these as separate isolated assets:
ROW 1-2, BIG NAMED BUILDINGS (each with its sign): (1) 'Escola Primária do Bairro de Fátima' - long single-storey ochre school with blue window frames, covered veranda, Angolan flag on a pole; (2) 'Liceu do Bairro de Fátima' - two-storey secondary school, cream with green trim; (3) 'Centro de Saúde do Bairro de Fátima' - white and light-blue health centre with a red cross; (4) 'Igreja Nossa Senhora de Fátima' - Catholic church with a white facade and bell tower; (5) 'Mercado do Bairro de Fátima' - covered market hall with a zinc roof and stalls inside; (6) 'Esquadra Policial de Fátima' - small police station painted blue and white; (7) 'Farmácia Fátima' - small pharmacy with a green cross; (8) 'Discoteca Kizomba Fátima' - night club with a neon sign and dark facade; (9) 'Pensão Fátima' - small two-storey guesthouse; (10) 'Cantina da Dona Rosa' - small grocery shop with a hand-painted sign and soft-drink adverts; (11) 'Churrasqueira Fátima' - grill restaurant with plastic tables under a canopy; (12) 'Administração do Bairro de Fátima' - small administration office with the Angolan flag; (13) 'Prédio Fátima' - four-storey apartment block with balconies; (14-21) EIGHT different family houses of the bairro (cement-block and colonial-style, zinc and tile roofs, painted walls, metal gates, small yards with walls).
ROWS 3-6, SMALL PROPS (about 95 items, each isolated): 10 trees (2 jacarandas in bloom, 2 eucalyptus, 2 palm trees, mulemba fig, mango tree, avocado tree, bougainvillea bush); 8 street lamps; 4 wooden electricity poles; 3 blue-and-white candongueiro minibuses; 4 kupapata motorbikes; 3 cars (Toyota Corolla, Toyota Hilux pickup, small hatchback); 6 zungueira and market stalls with fruit and vegetables; 4 waste containers; 4 public benches; 3 rooftop water tanks; 2 small generators; 3 bus-stop shelters; 4 flower pots; 3 bicycles; 4 piles of cement blocks; 2 wheelbarrows; 3 yellow water jerrycans; 3 chickens; 2 goats; 2 street signs reading 'Bairro de Fátima'; 2 Angolan flags on poles; 1 ATM kiosk; 3 mobile-phone credit kiosks (yellow and orange); 2 sacks of charcoal; 1 public water tap; 2 plastic chairs and tables sets; 2 gas cylinders; 1 wooden cart; 2 small concrete walls with gates.
Every item fully separated by transparent space so each one can be cut out automatically.
